_comment: Ratchets for npm run check. Numbers may only go down. Targets from docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-19-app-refactor.md: 600 lines per file, 80 lines per function, 0 unreachable functions. Lines are counted as check-structure counts them: the text split at its newlines, so a file that ends in a newline counts one more than wc -l.

deadCode._note: maxUnusedImports came in with stage 09b's fix wave at 18: named imports nothing in their module uses, every one in a file the stage did not touch (server/routes and others; npm run check:dead-code lists them). Stage 12 took it to 8 once its lanes were merged — the 2.x roster editor's, the 2.x season's and administration's went with them. Lower it as they go. Stage 13 took it to 6 (Task 25) once Tasks 3 and 7 had dropped the last two in src (`patch`, `dataAttributes`); the six left are all in server/, which stage 13 does not change.

_notes.src/app.js: Task 6 walked this down 6210 -> 157: theme/i18n/reference, core/dom.mjs, core/markdown.mjs, core/routes.mjs, then the screens in 6.5-6.8, then 6.9's components/auth-modal.mjs and core/router.mjs. What is left is bootstrap. Went 157 -> 160 for the stale-locale-chrome fix: an import, a comment and an onLocaleChange registration, which is the smallest form that fix takes. Bugfixes may cost a line; drift may not. Stage 05 Task 14 put the 3.0 frame on the page (src/shell/shell.mjs) and dropped the 2.x sidebar, top bar, language toggle and sign-in button with their wiring: 160 -> 120. Stage 13 (Task 25) brought both budgets down to the file: 120 -> 110 lines, and 180 -> 18 for its longest function, init(); the 180 dated from before Task 6's split.
_notes.scripts/backup/status.mjs: Arrived with the nightly-backup work on main, which was written before this branch's check-structure existed and so never ran against it. evaluateSystemdState() is 108 lines. Inherited, not drift — lower it when that file is next touched.
_notes.server/server.mjs: Step 4.9 split this file 1935 -> 213: response plumbing, the pool, env loading, row serializers, sessions, the season and six route modules. Step 17.1 took static serving out too (server/http/static.mjs), leaving 164 — startup, the route table, and the HTTP server itself. Step 13.3 then found 24 imports the split had left behind, unused: 148. One line back (148 -> 149) for the startup line naming which root the site is served from: production was serving the repository root, where module imports carry no version, so the deploy fix had no effect where it mattered. Release 2.1.0 moved ensureAdmin() to server/auth/admin-account.mjs and added the maintenance gate's import and call: 128. Stage 03 moved the route chain and handleApi to server/routes/index.mjs so tests run the same chain.
_notes.server/season/rounds.mjs: generateSwissRound() was 88 lines, inherited from server.mjs. Task 14.5 moved the pairing out to server/season/pairing.mjs and replaced the greedy pass with a search: 83. What is left is the round transaction itself.
_notes.scripts/build-data.mjs: 794 -> 805 for step 16.1, a bug fix: the client decided which medical staff a team may hire by matching English words against a translated sentence, so no Russian coach could hire an apothecary. The build now derives access tokens from the English vault and copies them onto both locales (scripts/lib/medical-access.mjs). The eleven lines here are the import, the two calls, and stripping the label the English vault writes twice. Three more (805 -> 808) for step 16.1: the build now refuses to write data with a missing price, roster or access token (scripts/lib/validate-data.mjs), which is the check that would have caught 16.2 on the day it was introduced. Stage 13 (Task 25): its longest function, buildLocaleData(), is 122 lines, so that budget came down 130 -> 122.
_notes.stylesheetRoots: Stage 13 (Task 25): the stylesheets under src count against defaultMaxFileLines as the modules do, lines only (a stylesheet has no functions). The longest is src/ui/match-board.css at 580 (wc -l 579); src/screens/teams/builder.css had reached 705 before Task 1 split it.
